title: Server
desc: Where this app keeps your money. Switching deletes nothing: each one keeps its own data.
localD: A private database inside this app. Works without internet. Once opened, it keeps collecting your bank data in the background until you quit the app.
removeText: The server and its data are not touched.
addD: The address of your own Money Manager, for example money.home or https://money.example.com.
name: Name (optional)
err_badAddress: That does not look like an address.
err_already: This server is already in the list.
err_unreachable: Could not reach that address. Check it, and that the server is on.
err_notMoney: That address answered, but it is not a Money Manager server.
err_certNo: The server's security certificate was not accepted.
